import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    java = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
    phase = sys.argv[3]
    classes = work / ('clean-classes' if phase == 'green-clean' else 'classes')
    classes.mkdir(exist_ok=False if phase == 'green-clean' else True)
    sources = [work / 'proof/LinuxCgroup.java', work / 'CgroupFixture.java', work / 'CgroupGate.java']
    compile_args = [str(java.with_name('javac')), '--release', '27', '-d', str(classes), *map(str, sources)]
    compiled = subprocess.run(compile_args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert compiled.returncode == 0, compiled.stderr
    membership = Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1]
    ancestor = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / membership.lstrip('/')
    parent = ancestor / ('java-cgroup-gate-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    parent.mkdir()
    fixtures = work / (phase + '-fixtures')
    fixtures.mkdir()
    args = [str(java), '-Djava.io.tmpdir=' + str(work), '-cp', str(classes), 'CgroupGate',
        str(parent), str(fixtures), str(classes), 'native']
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=50)
    finally:
        (parent / 'cgroup.kill').write_text('1')
        for directory in sorted((p for p in parent.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()), reverse=True):
            directory.rmdir()
        parent.rmdir()
    receipt = {'phase': phase, 'compile': {'arguments': compile_args, 'exit': compiled.returncode,
        'stdout': compiled.stdout, 'stderr': compiled.stderr}, 'run': {'arguments': args,
        'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr},
        'sources': {str(p.relative_to(work)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sources},
        'parent_removed': parent.exists() is False}
    (work / (phase + '-receipt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
    if phase == 'red':
        assert result.returncode == 1
        assert 'Live nested child was reported unpopulated' in result.stderr
    else:
        assert result.returncode == 0
        assert all(mode + '=passed' in result.stdout for mode in ('terminate', 'close', 'interrupted-close'))
    print(phase + '=verified', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile

request = urllib.request.Request(
    'https://api.github.com/repos/holdmyspot-com/codex-unleashed/contents/docs/evidence/linux-java-natural-completion.json?ref=8ac718e954375c5d50f7c7f392008d8af0aadec8',
    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['GH_TOKEN'], 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.raw+json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
    evidence = response.read()
(work / 'evidence.json').write_bytes(evidence)
runtime = json.loads(evidence)['runtime_resolution']
archive = work / 'jdk.tar.gz'
urllib.request.urlretrieve(runtime['x86_64_url'], archive)
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == runtime['x86_64_archive_sha256']
with tarfile.open(archive) as contents:
    contents.extractall(work, filter='data')
java = next(work.glob('zulu*/bin/java'))
(work / 'java-path').write_text(str(java))
print('jdk_verified=' + runtime['x86_64_archive_sha256'])

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse
import uuid


def matches_origin(value, expected):
    location = urlparse(value)
    return (location.scheme == 'file' and location.netloc == '' and
        Path(unquote(location.path)) == expected)


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    java = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
    manifest = json.loads((work / 'module-manifest.json').read_text())
    modules = work / 'modules'
    owner = modules / manifest['owner']['name']
    assert hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == manifest['owner']['sha256']
    for dependency in manifest['dependencies']:
        destination = modules / dependency['name']
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(dependency['url'], destination)
        assert hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == dependency['sha256']
    source_directory = work / 'module-driver-src'
    source_directory.mkdir()
    original = (work / 'CgroupGate.java').read_text()
    signature = 'public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception\n    {'
    assert original.count(signature) == 1
    source_directory.joinpath('CgroupGate.java').write_text(original.replace(signature, signature +
        '\n        System.out.println("owner_module=" + LinuxCgroup.class.getModule().getName());' +
        '\n        System.out.println("owner_origin=" + LinuxCgroup.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation());'))
    source_directory.joinpath('CgroupFixture.java').write_text((work / 'CgroupFixture.java').read_text())
    classes = work / 'module-driver-classes'
    classes.mkdir()
    module_flags = ['--module-path', str(modules), '--add-modules', 'com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling',
        '--add-exports', 'com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling/com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.scheduler=ALL-UNNAMED']
    compile_args = [str(java.with_name('javac')), '--release', '27', *module_flags, '-d', str(classes),
        str(source_directory / 'CgroupGate.java'), str(source_directory / 'CgroupFixture.java')]
    compiled = subprocess.run(compile_args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert compiled.returncode == 0, compiled.stderr
    membership = Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1]
    parent = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / membership.lstrip('/') / ('module-cgroup-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    parent.mkdir()
    fixtures = work / 'module-fixtures'
    fixtures.mkdir()
    args = [str(java), '-Djava.io.tmpdir=' + str(work), *module_flags, '-cp', str(classes),
        'CgroupGate', str(parent), str(fixtures), str(classes), 'native']
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=50)
    finally:
        (parent / 'cgroup.kill').write_text('1')
        for directory in sorted((p for p in parent.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()), reverse=True):
            directory.rmdir()
        parent.rmdir()
    receipt = {'manifest': manifest,
        'compile': {'arguments': compile_args, 'exit': compiled.returncode, 'stdout': compiled.stdout, 'stderr': compiled.stderr},
        'run': {'arguments': args, 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr},
        'driver_sources': {p.name: {'text': p.read_text(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
            for p in source_directory.iterdir()}, 'parent_removed': parent.exists() is False}
    (work / 'module-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert 'owner_module=com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling' in result.stdout
    origin = next(line.split('=', 1)[1] for line in result.stdout.splitlines()
        if line.startswith('owner_origin='))
    assert matches_origin(origin, owner)
    assert all(mode + '=passed' in result.stdout for mode in ('terminate', 'close', 'interrupted-close'))
    print('actual_module=passed', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
